sprintGoal: 把 Gate A replay contract、自测矩阵、rollback matrix 和 `IPD-20260610-PLATFORM-001` 回放 / 产品主线消费顺序固定下来，并同时留下 Gate B / Gate C 的后续能力门入口；`IPD-20260611-PLATFORM-001` 作为已完成全链路 replay 的证据基线保留。

tasks.title: 冻结 Gate A replay 合同
tasks.deliverable: 明确 ceo-demand 到 intelligence 的 replay 顺序、进入条件和暂停条件

tasks.title: 定义 source-side 自测矩阵
tasks.deliverable: runtime、CLI、focused regression 和 stage-output 行为的固定检查矩阵

tasks.title: 固化 Discovery competitor carry-forward guard
tasks.deliverable: Discovery 自动化可以扩展更多竞品，但 CEO seeded competitors 必须被 catalog / brief / landscape 覆盖，缺失时阻断或标记 revision-required

tasks.title: 锁定 rollback matrix 与 replay gate
tasks.deliverable: ceo-demand、task-dispatch、discovery 三个主回退锚点规则，以及 replay 失败后的分流标准

tasks.title: 形成 Gate B / Gate C capability map
tasks.deliverable: designing 到 delivery 的逐段放行框架与验收关注点

tasks.title: 定义 release validation path
tasks.deliverable: workflow sprint -> source-side 自测 -> proving-ground replay -> 继续/冻结/回退 的固定验证路径

slices: 先固定 source-side 自测矩阵，再进入 execution
Discovery competitor carry-forward guard 先固定：允许扩展更多竞品，但 seeded competitors 不能静默消失
`IPD-20260610-PLATFORM-001` 在 replay 前必须保持当前 Discovery baseline / replay surface
任何 replay 失败都必须先套用 rollback matrix 再回流 workflow sprint
Gate B / Gate C 的 map 必须在 planning 阶段明确留下入口

exitCriteria: Discovery competitor carry-forward guard fixed and routed to CTO for implementation
rollback matrix and replay gate fixed
Gate B and Gate C capability map drafted
execution can proceed without re-opening planning ambiguity
boundaryGuards: Do not use this sprint to claim PLATFORM delivery work itself is complete.
Do not collapse the full-stage optimization goal back into Discovery/Intelligence-only language.
Do not let CEOChiefOfStaff become the default process-code modifier when the task belongs to CTO.
